ad_library.summary: 2 live Meta ads confirmed on 2026-11-21 by opening each library ID directly. Both ads are in Telugu and sell rooftop solar in Karimnagar with the Rs.78,000 PM Surya Ghar subsidy, bank loan and 25-30 year warranty. One ad clicks to a URL link, the other to a Facebook lead form (FB.ME). The company website laxminarayanasolar.in returns HTTP 500, so no website audit was run for this report. Google Ads Transparency records were not checked in this pass.

funnel.type: Mixed: URL link and Facebook lead form
funnel.destination: Ad 1: URL link. Ad 2: Facebook lead form (FB.ME).
funnel.meaning: The two live ads do not agree on where the click lands. One points at a URL, the other at an FB.ME lead form, so the spend cannot be measured in one place.

findings: The company website laxminarayanasolar.in returns HTTP 500, so ad traffic that does reach the web has nowhere to land. This is the single biggest leak in the funnel.
The two live ads do not agree on the destination - one is a URL link, the other an FB.ME lead form - so the spend cannot be measured in one place.
Both ads are in Telugu, which is right for Karimnagar, but the website (when it loads) and the lead form do not carry the same Rs.78,000 subsidy figure in a way a visitor can verify.
The ads promise zero maintenance and a 25-30 year warranty, but there is no live website page to confirm what those cover.
No website audit was run for this report because the site is down; every website claim is therefore left unmade rather than guessed.
next_steps: The site returns HTTP 500, so every rupee currently lands on a dead page or a lead form. Restore the site before spending more on ads.
Point both ads at the same destination (the website landing page) with a Meta Pixel so the click can be measured and retargeted.
Publish the offer on the landing page
Put the Rs.78,000 subsidy, bank-loan and warranty terms on the landing page so the ad promise can be verified in one click.
Re-run the full website audit once the site is back, then re-issue this report as a complete audit.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
